children.summary: Predicting key tanker market developments for 2026 We are only a few weeks into 2026, and we have already seen major geopolitical developments in countries that are important to the tanker markets: Venezuela and Iran. If this is any indication of what we are in for in 2026, it will be a rollercoaster ride.
